rules.title: RevenueDot Cordova SDK
rules.description: RevenueDot's MIT fork of RevenueCat's Cordova plugin, pointed at RevenueDot, the open-source RevenueCat alternative for in-app purchases and subscriptions.
rules: Install with `cordova plugin add {{npmScope}}/cordova-plugin-purchases@<version>`. The plugin id stays cordova-plugin-purchases and the global stays `Purchases`.
Call `Purchases.configureWith` after the `deviceready` event, with the app's public key from the RevenueDot dashboard: appl_ for iOS and goog_ for Android.
RevenueDot Cloud ({{apiHost}}) is the default API host. For a self-hosted server, call `Purchases.setProxyURL("https://revenuedot.example.com")` before `configureWith`.

rules.title: RevenueDot Cordova SDK
install: The plugin id stays `cordova-plugin-purchases` and the global stays `Purchases`, so `config.xml` and your code do not change. The native side is RevenueDot's `RevenueDotPurchasesHybridCommon` pod and `{{mavenGroup}}:purchases-hybrid-common`.

code: // Self-hosted server only: RevenueDot Cloud ({{apiHost}}) is the default.
Purchases.configureWith({ apiKey: device.platform === "iOS" ? "appl_..." : "goog_..." });   // each app's public key

adds: **Start for free on [RevenueDot Cloud](https://app.revenuedot.app/signup)**: free until your apps make $10,000 a month, then 0.5%, never more than $999 a month ([pricing](https://revenuedot.app/pricing)).
**The same REST API and webhook payloads** as RevenueCat, so your backend and integrations keep working ([API reference](https://revenuedot.app/docs/api)).
**Experiments, targeting and the Customer Center** run from the RevenueDot dashboard on the offerings this plugin fetches ([guides](https://revenuedot.app/docs/guides)).
**A one-line migration:** point the stock plugin at RevenueDot with `setProxyURL`, or install this fork and drop the line ([migration guide](https://revenuedot.app/docs/migrate)).
